name: Fujian Haiqin Energy Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Fujian Haiqin Energy Group Co., Ltd. engages in the bulk commodity supply chain business in China. It is involved in trading of coal. Fujian Haiqin Energy Group Co., Ltd. was formerly known as GEN-S POWER Group Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Fujian Haiqin Energy Group Co., Ltd. in May 2025. Fujian Haiqin Energy Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is based in Fuzhou, China.
